title: CMS Channel
description: Represents a CMS delivery channel used for publishing and delivering managed content to Experience Cloud sites or external applications.

channelId.description: Unique identifier of the CMS channel

domain.description: Domain associated with the channel for content delivery

domainName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the channel

isDomainLocked.description: Whether the domain is locked and cannot be changed

isSearchable.description: Whether content in this channel is searchable by site visitors
